nodes.itemHTML: • alejandrastars178 - An opinionated Nix code formatter optimized for speed and consistency.

• composer-plugin-nixifystars11 - Composer plugin to help with Nix packaging.

• nixpkgs-mozillastars372 - Mozilla's overlay with Rust toolchains and Firefox.
• rust-overlaystars271 - Pure and reproducible nix overlay of binary distributed Rust toolchains.

• nixpkgs PR tracker - A tracker for whether a PR has made it into a channel yet.

• nixpkgs-hammeringstars133 - Beat your package expressions into a shape.

• nixpkgs-fmtstars308 - Nix code formatter for nixpkgs.

• elm2nixstars83 - Convert elm.json into Nix expressions.

• KubeNixstars275 - A Kubernetes resource builder using Nix.

• NixOpsstars1.1k - The official Nix deployment tool, compatible with AWS, Hetzner, and more.

• nixpkgs-reviewstars182 - The best tool to verify that a pull-request in Nixpkgs is building properly.
